verdict.rationale: First-party Codex docs explicitly say cloud tasks can be started from GitHub pull requests, GitLab merge requests and issues, Linear issues, and Slack channels and threads, which covers all four named surfaces. Related docs describe reviewing the resulting diff, requesting follow-ups, and opening a PR. The evidence is limited to brief marketing-level statements, though. missing for 10: detailed setup/integration docs for each surface (how triggers work, required permissions), independent or hands-on corroboration that these integrations work in practice.
